alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. A full glass of water sits on the table on the right under a small clock that reads 9:00. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes glances at it with a happy pulse each time the clock moves on, 11:00, 1:00, 3:00, 5:00, and wanders off again. In the last second the text changes from: me drinking more water starting today, to: the glass: still full. The figure's eyes go wide and it trembles. It narrows its eyes at the camera.
